messages.title: First public Garda release
body: Visible release history was reset to the Garda 1.0.0 baseline.
The public project line now uses the Garda name.

messages.title: Project memory refresh
body: Project memory mode was updated in 1.1.0.
Before starting task work, let your agent execute the project-memory refresh prompt so local project memory is current for the new workflow.
New or refreshed workflow configs now default full-suite validation placement to after_compile_before_reviews; existing explicit placement settings are preserved.

Garda self-guard is enabled by default for application workspaces: agents can no longer self-escalate into --orchestrator-work for protected Garda bundle edits. Operators can change the policy with garda workflow set --garda-self-guard on|off.

messages.title: Optional quality gate controls
body: Garda now includes an optional quality gate for project-specific self-check rules before expensive validation work.
After updating, run garda ui --actions and open the Quality Gate settings to review the default rules, adjust test-only exclusions, and add rules that match your project.
This gate is advisory and does not replace mandatory compile, full-suite, or independent review gates.

messages.title: Review finding actions, F-task policies, and faster navigation
body: Profiles can now decide by finding severity and residual risk whether review feedback uses fix_now, create_follow_up, or ignore; critical findings always remain fix_now.
F-task materialization is now policy-driven: grouped_by_parent creates one pending F-task after all required review lanes finish, while per_finding creates one F-task for each deferred item.

After updating, open garda ui --actions to review each profile's Review Finding Disposition settings; garda profile current also shows the active ReviewFollowUpPolicy, and profile changes apply only to future tasks.
next-step now batches and reuses Git and workspace reads, reducing repeated navigation work on large repositories.
Garda now uses a workspace-local SQLite projection for large task-activity and project-memory searches, with automatic canonical-file fallback when SQLite or FTS5 is unavailable.

messages.title: Extensible reviews and safer remediation
body: Garda 1.4.2 adds a guarded review catalog for custom review lanes, profile states, and dependency graphs, with matching CLI and local UI controls.
Review remediation can now reuse authenticated evidence or run a bounded DELTA review; stale, ambiguous, protected, oversized, or dependency-invalidated changes continue through a full review.
After updating, run garda review-catalog validate --target-root "." to inspect the effective configuration. Existing workspaces remain compatible without a mandatory migration.

Use garda review-catalog migrate --target-root "." only to preview an explicit normalized catalog for a legacy workspace; the preview is read-only and custom lanes remain disabled until deliberately configured.
